title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
why_read: A solid but fairly narrow medical imaging detection paper combining multiple annotated datasets into one multi-domain model.
analysis: The authors build a detection model that learns from several differently-labeled medical imaging datasets at once, using a student-teacher training setup to avoid forgetting earlier knowledge. They report modest but real accuracy improvements on chest X-rays and mammography compared to single-dataset training. This is useful incremental progress for people working specifically in medical image AI, but the techniques (multi-task learning, example-based detection) are not conceptually new to the broader ML audience. Interest is mostly limited to specialists in clinical imaging AI.
